Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I would like to know what happens when vampire A (with no blood on
him) goes hunting and vampire B blocks and plays an Obedience in
minor.

Is it like with Pulled Fangs ? (when the vampire must hunt and cannot
he goes to torpor)

Thanks,

Rafid

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Rafid Armani wrote:
>
> Hi,
>
> I would like to know what happens when vampire A (with no blood on
> him) goes hunting and vampire B blocks and plays an Obedience in
> minor.

Then the acting minion untaps. The vampire is stuck (ready empty vampires
cannot take any action other than "hunt", and he can't hunt). Same thing if
the hunt is successful and the vampire uses Freak Drive to untap (and you're
using the NRA rule).

> Is it like with Pulled Fangs ? (when the vampire must hunt and cannot
> he goes to torpor)

No, since there's no effect to indicate that the vampire will go to
torpor.
